title: Offboarding module completely disabled — `OFFBOARDING_ENABLED = false` hard-coded; 7-phase workflow unreachable; no coming-soon indicator; A.5.19 / A.8.30 certification blocker
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/app/(private)/vendors/offboarding/page.jsx` **Root Cause:** `OFFBOARDING_ENABLED = false` hardcoded. The 7-phase offboarding workflow is completely unreachable. No coming-soon indicator or placeholder is shown — the page is invisible. **Impact:** ISO 27001 Annex A 5.19 requires documented supplier termination procedures. A.8.30 requires access revocation on contract end. No offboarding evidence can be produced for any terminated vendor. **Claude Fix Prompt:** Short-term: `if (!OFFBOARDING_ENABLED) return (

Vendor Offboarding

Coming soon — this feature is currently in development.

);`. Long-term: set `OFFBOARDING_ENABLED = true` and verify all 7 phases have working backend endpoints.

title: Analytics RiskDistributionCard renders hardcoded fake data — `data?.critical || 2`, `|| 5`, `|| 8`, `|| 12`; fabricated risk distribution shown when API returns null; management review artefacts fictional
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorAnalytics.jsx` **Root Cause:** `data?.critical || 2`, `data?.high || 5`, `data?.medium || 8`, `data?.low || 12` — hardcoded fallback values display fabricated risk distribution when the API returns null or is unavailable. **Impact:** Management review reports and board dashboards containing analytics screenshots show fabricated vendor risk metrics. Any certification audit presenting this data as evidence is presenting fictional numbers. **Claude Fix Prompt:** Replace all hardcoded fallbacks with `|| 0`: `critical: data?.critical || 0`, `high: data?.high || 0`, `medium: data?.medium || 0`, `low: data?.low || 0`. Add empty state: `if (!data) return (

No risk data available

);`.
